name: Dola
oneLiner: DOLA is Inverse Finance's CDP-style dollar issued through FiRM lending and a USDS PSM rail, with permissioned mint authority outside collateralized borrowing.
collateral: Overcollateralized FiRM loans, predominantly secured by DOLA-paired stablecoin LP tokens; these debt claims are not wholly external stablecoin reserves. Permissioned operator minting is not collateral-gated. The USDS PSM is a swap rail; both reviewed deployments held no USDS or sUSDS at Ethereum block 26214783 (2026-10-17T20:51:59Z).
pegMechanism: FiRM Fed issuance supports fixed-rate collateralized borrowing, while the PSM provides a USDS swap rail. Frontier is deprecated, with no new borrowing; its Fed shrinks as legacy bad debt is repaid but remains an authorized minter. The 48-hour Timelock operator can also mint without a collateral check or numeric token cap.

notices.title: Historical oracle-manipulation incident
notices.message: Inverse Finance suffered an April 2022 oracle-manipulation exploit that let an attacker borrow and withdraw DOLA against manipulated collateral, leaving bad debt through the stablecoin issuance route.

notices.title: Polygon fxDOLA representation
notices.message: The listed Polygon contract is fxDOLA, the FxPortal representation of Ethereum DOLA, not native Polygon issuance. Its symbol and 18 decimals were confirmed at Polygon block 95710090 (2026-10-17T20:54:42Z).

notices.title: Legacy third-party bridge representations
notices.message: The BSC and Fantom contracts are legacy Multichain/Anyswap representations; Avalanche is also retained as a legacy third-party bridge representation. All three had outstanding supply in the October 17, 2026 review. Their token balances do not establish a live bridge, solvent backing, or redemption at par.
